review_locator: PMCID:PMC5477003, CD40L and Its Receptors in Atherothrombosis—An Update; PMCID:PMC7892683, The CD40-CD40L Dyad as Immunotherapeutic Target in Cardiovascular Disease
primary_title: CD40 ligand mediates inflammation independently of CD40 by interaction with Mac-1; Binding of CD40L to Mac-1's I-domain involves the EQLKKSKTL motif and mediates leukocyte recruitment and atherosclerosis—but does not affect immunity and thrombosis in mice
decision_basis: The CD40L receptor reviews cite primary studies showing CD40L interaction with Mac-1, Mac-1 I-domain binding, and Mac-1-dependent inflammatory-cell adhesion/migration; the interaction is a biased adhesive ligand branch.
limitations_preserved: Preserve trimeric/membrane versus soluble CD40L, activated Mac-1 I-domain, biased-agonist/no outside-in signaling semantics, and vascular inflammation context; no SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4510953, Platelets and their interactions with other immune cells; PMCID:PMC6971330, The dual role of platelet-innate immune cell interactions in thrombo-inflammation
primary_title: Leukocyte integrin Mac-1 (CD11b/CD18, alphaMbeta2, CR3) acts as a functional receptor for platelet factor 4
decision_basis: The platelet/leukocyte reviews cite the primary study identifying PF4 as a Mac-1 ligand, with direct alphaM I-domain binding and Mac-1-dependent leukocyte adhesion, migration, and phagocytosis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve PF4 tetramer/charge and heparan-sulfate or cell-surface-proteoglycan cooperation, alphaM I-domain binding, platelet-derived alarmin context, and no SCI inference.
